game.name: Sonic's Ultimate Genesis Collection (Europe)
game.desc: Sega Megadrive Ultimate Collection for Xbox 360 is a compilation of many classic Megadrive titles, including Sonic the Hedgehog, Streets of Rage, Ecco the Dolphin, Shining Force, Golden Axe, Phantasy Star, Alex Kidd, Shinobi, Altered Beast and many more. The game also gives you the opportunity to unlock Sega titles released in arcade or on Master System.
